jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer (Level II Guard) – Patrol & Reports
jobs.description:
Marksman Security is hiring an unarmed Security Officer in Arlington, TX. The role requires a Level II Guard License, a valid Texas driver’s license, a high school diploma or equivalent, and a professional demeanor.

You will conduct patrols, maintain a visible presence, document reports, and communicate with the client and team to ensure safety and compliance. The job demands physical stamina and reliability, with pre-employment screening and standard background checks.
